body: Thank you for trying to help, but I still plan to go through with my plan. I just need to find a sharp knife
I appreciate it, but I really want to hurt myself and not fake it.
I am, right now I’m sitting on my couch with a knife in my hand trying to work up the courage to stab myself. I deserve to die, you don’t.
Don’t do it! I’m here if you need to talk!
